data.name: Private Charter for 14-30 people
data.headline: All ages! 🌺
data.description: 🌴☀️ Enjoy a fun, tropical tiki-themed private charter with up to 30 guests. Includes a USCG licensed captain, host & bartender. 🍹
data.highlights:
🌺 Cruise around San Diego Bay - you tell us where you want to go!
🌺 Licensed captain, host, and bartender included.
🌺 Bathroom on board.
🌺 Play your own music with our premium Bluetooth sound system.		
🌺 Enjoy premium Cutwater spirits, beer, and hard seltzer.

meeting_point.address: 2803 Emerson Street San Diego, CA US 92106

data.what_is_included:
🌺 USCG licensed captain, host, and bartender.
🌺 All gas, marina and port fees included.
🌺Alcohol available for purchase (premium Cutwater spirits, beer, and hard seltzer).
🌺 Bluetooth sound system - listen to our Tiki tunes or play your own!
🌺 Bathroom on board.
data.what_is_not_included:
🌺 Alcohol (available for purchase on board). **No BYOB permitted.**
🌺 Food (guests are welcome to bring their own). No cooking or heating permitted on board. 
🌺 A $150 cleaning fee hold will be placed on your card at the start of your charter.  It will be released after your charter barring no excessive cleaning is needed.
🌺 Trip insurance (optional for $85).
data.what_to_bring:
🌺 Good vibes!
🌺 Photo ID for drink purchases.
🌺 Jacket in the cooler months.
🌺 Sunscreen, swim suits, & towels if you'd like to swim.
data.cancellation_notes:
**Private Charter Cancellation Policy**
All reservations are non-refundable unless trip insurance is purchased, which is $85. This allows cancelations up to 7 days before your charter and you’ll receive a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
Aloha!
We’re stoked you booked with us for your special event! Our charter team will be sliding into your inbox within 48 hours with all the details, an agreement, and answers to any questions you’ve got. Can’t wait to make this an unforgettable experience for you!  
Mahalo! 🤙🌺
data.check_in_details: 🌺 All guests should plan to arrive to the Point Loma area 30 minutes prior to departure to allow for parking and walking to our marina.
data.accessibility: Ramp and step access; staff assistance available
data.restrictions:
🌺 No BYOB.
🌺 No pets or animals.
data.disclaimers:
🌺 Pricing includes taxes, fees, crew, and fuel.
🌺 Prices range from $575 - $750 per hour, based on season, date, and availability.
🌺 Trip insurance available for $85. **Trip insurance must be selected and paid for at time of checkout. It cannot be selected after your charter deposit has been made.**	
🌺 A $150 cleaning fee hold will be placed on your card at the start of your charter.  It will be released after your charter barring no excessive cleaning is needed. This hold will be returned in full provided there are no major messes, clogged toilet, or excessive cleaning required. Routine cleaning is always  included, but spills, stains, or any extraordinary messes beyond normal use may result in partial or full forfeiture of the deposit.		
🌺 If your group arrives 45 mins or later than your scheduled start time, your charter will be canceled and no refunds will be offered.
data.faqs:
🌺 Caught Between Two Crew Sizes?
If your guest list is doing the limbo between 1–13 and 14–30 people, go ahead and book the 1–13 option. If a few extra island-hoppers join the party and you cruise past 13, we’ll just charge the card on file for the difference. No biggie. 

Overestimated your popularity and booked for too many? Oof. Do better. 😆 Kidding… mostly. While we can’t offer refunds for a smaller-than-expected crew, we can give you a credit to use toward public tickets or another private charter.

Moral of the story: when in doubt, book the smaller crew and let the tiki gods sort out the rest. 🤙
